_: Copy to empaquetar.local.json (never commit it) and fill in your own data. sanear = [text, replacement] applied in this order to the .py files copied into the package (e.g. your character name in comments, your development account id); escaneo = regular expressions (case-insensitive) that stop the build if they appear in the package text (e.g. your Windows user folder, your names). The IP scan is always on.
